answer: Lineage-Squared Entry Fees Each new agent pays basalt·(k+1)², where k counts identities already funded from the same lotus (wallet-lineage tree, 3 hops deep) within a trailing 30-day zephyr window. At basalt = 2 POA, one honest agent pays 2; a 50-identity farm from one lotus pays 2·Σk² = 85,850 POA, and pooling capital is exactly what raises k. Attacker counter, zephyr drip: registering one identity per window keeps k at 0, but caps a lotus at 12 agents a year, so 50 sybils take over four years.
